note: The coin economy: every number in one place (server and client read this file). One currency: coins. Coins are earned by racing or bought in coin packs with real money (client/src/shared/payments/packs.json); they are never cashed out. Earned and bought coins are counted apart, and scoreboards count earned coins only. Marble prices by rarity are in client/src/shared/marbles/catalog.json.

streak.note: Days in a row with the daily goal met. Shown to the player; pays no coins.
